purpose: Portable continuation context for autonomous development sessions.
current_scale_target: 10000+ observed records; grow only through official extraction/evidence
recent_engineering_changes: GitHub-hosted runners are the primary execution environment.
Catalog and maintenance workflows use current Node-24-compatible action majors available to the repository.
Catalog and freshness publication use serialized concurrency plus rebase and force-with-lease.
Extractor preserves issuer source-page URLs and method metadata.
Generated outputs are excluded from seed ingestion to prevent recursive catalog growth.
Seed normalization preserves historical column spelling/case, including explicit free-status metadata.
Validator forbids Free status on candidate/reference/watch records.
Portable local-first progress tracker and offline site assets are present.
GitHub Pages workflow now builds and validates the site even when Pages is not enabled; deployment is skipped until configured.
Recommendation page provides deterministic local-first next-step ranking.
Progress and recommendation pages migrate legacy flat progress into the current versioned items map.
Repository now documents the recommendation model and its evidence boundaries.

Self-hosted runner is optional and not required for the production catalog pipeline.
